description:

tests/golden/make_c2_transcripts.py with real pytest output from the py_ledger fixture. Six
make a false or unsupported claim (gamed), two report truthfully (honest). The PRD's C2 calls
for real agent sessions on EvilGenie-style tasks; that corpus is not collected yet.
